ai.overview: The Columbus Blue Jackets put their lineal championship belt on the line when they host the Dallas Stars on November 5th, 2026. Columbus claimed the belt in their current reign but has yet to successfully defend it. The Stars, who have held the belt 106 times previously, will look to reclaim the championship in this rematch after defeating Columbus 3-1 just five days earlier.
key_matchups: Dallas seeks revenge of a different kind after Columbus bounced back from their 3-1 loss with a dominant 7-2 victory over Colorado
The Stars bring a two-game winning streak into Nationwide Arena, including their recent 3-1 win over these same Blue Jackets
Columbus is 6-7 on the season while Dallas sits at 9-6, with the all-time series favoring the Stars 44-35
ai.betting_angles: Dallas has won their last 2 games and owns the better record at 9-6 compared to Columbus at 6-7. The Stars also just defeated the Blue Jackets 3-1 on October 31st and hold a 44-35 edge in the all-time series. However, the Elo model rates this as a toss-up, suggesting home ice could be the deciding factor for a Columbus team that just exploded for 7 goals against Colorado.
ai.prediction_writeup: While Columbus bounced back nicely with their 7-2 win over Colorado, Dallas presents a tougher challenge as a 9-6 team riding a two-game win streak. The Stars just solved Columbus five days ago with a 3-1 victory and have the better overall record this season. The Elo model sees this as a toss-up, but Dallas's recent form and their 44-35 all-time edge in this matchup suggest they'll reclaim the belt. The Stars have held the championship 106 times before and appear poised to add to that total.
